content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-73. - Purchaser not responsible for application of proceeds.
content.summary:
The purchaser of the bonds shall in no manner be responsible for the application of
               the proceeds of the bonds by the city or by any of its officers, agents and employees.
(Code 1981, § 27-74; Ord. No. 551, § 25(I), 5-14-1964)
